properties.description: Attractive three bedroom semi-detached family home situated within 0.5 miles of Petts Wood station with fast trains to London and within easy walking distance of local shops, schools, bus routes and National Trust woodland. The property comprises; two receptions, fitted 18'9 x 10'1 kitchen/breakfast room and conservatory. The property also benefits from having a utility room and cloakroom. To the first floor there are three bedrooms and a family bathroom with separate WC. Additional features include double glazing, gas central heating and a well presented interior...
properties.location: Petts Wood Road, Petts Wood, Orpington BR5

properties.description:
Presented in excellent decorative order throughout is this two double bedroom, two bathroom, garden flat.
The modern fitted kitchen is open plan to the living room which boasts solid wooden floors and includes integrated appliances including a dishwasher & a washing machine. This large open plan benefits from bi folding doors onto a secluded private courtyard garden. Both bedrooms are double sized, and the family bathroom boasts a matching three piece suite a shower attachment over the bath. There is also a separate wet room. There are walnut doors throughout and wiring for Sky TV/aerial points in the living room/kitchen and both bedrooms.
This apartment being only five years old, is still under a 10 year building guarantee...

A beautifully presented three bedroom semi-detached family home located in a quiet residential road. The property features a spacious living room with large windows, a modern fitted kitchen with integrated appliances, and a seperate dining area. Upstairs offers three well-proportioned bedrooms and a contemporary family bathroom. The rear garden is well maintined and ideal for entertaining. Additional benefits include off street parking and gas central heating.

This modern one bedroom apartment is situated on the second floor of a purpose-built development. The property comprises a bright open-plan living and kitchen area, a spacious double bedroom with built-in wardrobes, and a stylish bathroom suite. Residents benefit from secure entry, lift access, and allocated parking. Ideal for first-time buyers or investors.

An impressive four bedroom detached house offering generous living spac throughout. The groundfloor features a large lounge, a separate dining room, a modern fitted kitchen with breakfast bar, and a downstairs WC. Upstairs provides four double bedrooms including a master with an- suite shower room, plus a family bathroom. The property also benefits from a private driveway, garage, and landscaped rear garden.

Located within a popular modern development, this two bedroom apartment offers contemporary living with excellent transport links nearby. The accommodation includes an open-plan kitchen/living area, two double bedrooms, ana a modern bathroom. The property benefits from double glazing, central heating, and access to communal gardens.

A substantial five bedroom period property offering a wealth of character features including high ceilings, original fireplaces, and large bay windows. The property provides versatile accommodation over three floors with multiple reception rooms, a spacious kitchen, and well-sized bedrooms. Externally, there is a large rear garden and on-street parking available.
